note: Species whose templates Nick has ratified (all 29 as of 2026-09-03, PR #73). Only these are bundled into packages/content/json/speciesRecords.json by scripts/bundleLore.js; *-run.* files and unratified drafts never ship. A new species is added here only after ratification. Frackworm (00030) was ratified 2026-09-09 as the thirtieth species; Sonalloy (00031) was ratified 2026-09-11 as the thirty-first.

records.name: Akinza
records.nameOrigin: A compressed blend of Norwegian kanin, rabbit, and German Katze, cat, reflecting its feline frame and oversized rabbit-like ears.

lore.description: This creature's incredible stealth and night vision allow it to sneak through the night with ease.
appearance: Slender and light in the frame
Large rabbit-like ears atop the head
Slender arms ending in clawed hands
lore.origin: Feral stock from the Krystos Generator after the impact, when the machine turned from making dainty, graceful creatures to lifeforms that could survive the frozen tundra.
lore.habitat: The arctic wastes outside the prison complexes of Krystos.
lore.feeding: It forages the tundra at night and eats what it finds.
lore.behavior: It moves at night, using its stealth and night vision to go unseen.
lore.company: It goes alone.

signatureAbility.name: Silence of the Long Night
signatureAbility.description: The Akinza crosses open snow without sound or track and is on its target before it has been seen.

records.name: Avilily
records.nameOrigin: A blend of avian and lily, joining its small bird body to its flower-like plumage and blooming beak.

lore.description: Carnivorous little green birds with bright, floral plumage, Avililies flit between Floria’s trees, camouflaging into the planet’s many flowery meadows as they travel. Their beaks resemble the closed petals of a flower but when they open their mouths that 'flower' blooms. They attract insects with their sweet, syrupy smelling saliva and vibrant floral display, but their saliva contains a powerful sedative which paralyzes anything that it comes in contact with. In ancient times, Avililies were used by Vallerii scientists and explorers to trap insects, serving as mobile bug repellent on Florian ventures. Today, the sedative properties of their saliva have been enhanced for a far-more dangerous galaxy, and swarms of flittering Avililies protect the most sacred parts of Floria’s jungles, paralyzing and consuming all who dare to threaten the pristineness of their forests.
appearance: Beak like the closed petals of a flower, opening into a bloom
Long streamer feathers trailing from the head
lore.origin: Used by Vallerii scientists and explorers as mobile bug repellent on Florian ventures, trapping insects with its saliva.
lore.habitat: The canopy of Floria's World Trees and its flowery meadows, where its plumage camouflages it.
lore.feeding: It eats only meat. It attracts insects with its floral display and sweet-smelling saliva, and the sedative in the saliva paralyzes them.
lore.behavior: It flits between the trees and hunts without chasing, waiting with its bill open. Its sedative has since been enhanced, and it paralyzes and consumes anything that threatens the sacred parts of the jungle.
lore.company: It lives in swarms.

signatureAbility.name: Blossoming Ambuscade
signatureAbility.description: The Avilily opens its beak into a false bloom and coats what comes to feed in a syrup that stops it where it stands.

records.name: Bioflim
records.nameOrigin: A stylized transposition of biofilm, evoking the regenerating slime layer that continually forms its protective surface.

lore.description: An acid slime organism protected by a thick rocky exoskeleton. Its slime can continually regenerate an outer shell, allowing for great defense.
appearance: Shapeless mass of acid slime, without limbs
A single eye in the hooded top
Thick rocky exoskeleton over the upper mass, continually regrown
Drips and runnels where the slime sags
lore.origin: Made by the Drainov Generator to live in the planet's acid swamps and chemical waste.
lore.habitat: The acid swamps and derelict chemical plants of Drainov.
lore.feeding: It feeds on whatever it settles over.
lore.behavior: It moves slowly, flowing through the swamps rather than over them, and its slime continually regrows the rocky shell around it.
lore.company: It lives alone.

signatureAbility.name: Everforming Carapace
signatureAbility.description: The slime beneath floods over the broken plates and hardens into new shell faster than the acid can take it away.

records.name: Chromocat
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of chroma, color or light, and cat, reflecting its photonic feline nature beneath an ordinarily albino coat.

lore.description: Used in ancient times to quickly harvest the vast crop yields of Luminax's fields, the large, albino feline known as the Chromocat possesses two sickle-shaped blades infused with pure ionized radiation that extend backwards from its front paws. These 'energy swords' allowed them to cut through grains with minimal effort, and their ability to enter a photonic-state and leap through fields at the speed of light meant they could comb through and harvest entire fields in record time. Today, their wicked speed and ionic blades allow them to seemingly 'teleport' around the battlefield, harassing their opponents by barraging them with rapid cuts in a slice-and-dice pattern so swift that reaction becomes nearly impossible.
appearance: Two sickle-shaped blades of ionized light sweeping back from the front paws
lore.origin: Made to harvest the vast crop yields of Luminax's fields, cutting through grain with the ionized blades behind its front paws.
lore.habitat: The sunward face of Luminax, among the old fields, oases and solar farms.
lore.feeding: It eats what the fields and oases give, meat and grain alike.
lore.behavior: It enters a photonic state and crosses ground at the speed of light, so it seems to teleport around a fight, harassing its opponent with rapid cuts too fast to react to.
lore.company: It worked the fields in numbers. Today it fights alone.

signatureAbility.name: Harvest at the Speed of Light
signatureAbility.description: The Chromocat crosses the ground to its target in its photonic state and opens it with a barrage of rapid cuts from its ionized sickles.

records.name: Codazzo
records.nameOrigin: Derived from the Italian coda, tail, naming the creature's exposed tail weapon and defining silhouette.

lore.description: This creature digs its body underground when spooked, exposing only its tail made of explosive barbs. If provoked, it won't hesitate to fire off a few projectiles, as its regenerative power can quickly grow more.
appearance: Spiny ridge down the neck and back
Long digging claws on the forelimbs
Thick tail ending in a fan of explosive barbs
lore.origin: Made by the Stonera Generator for a world that takes a planetwide bombardment every year, where going underground fast is what keeps a creature alive.
lore.habitat: The fissured rock and crater fields of Stonera, worked from beneath.
lore.feeding: It feeds on what it digs up and on what comes too near its burrow.
lore.behavior: When spooked it digs itself underground and leaves only its tail of explosive barbs exposed. If provoked it fires a few of them, and its regenerative power quickly grows more.
lore.company: It lives alone in its burrow.

signatureAbility.name: Buried Quiver
signatureAbility.description: The Codazzo sinks its body into the ground until only the tail stands clear, then fires barbs at whatever comes near and grows them back.

records.name: Crystorn
records.nameOrigin: A compression of crystal and horn, naming the paired head gems through which it releases stored light.

lore.description: The gems growing out of this creature's head transmit powerful light energy, don't be deceived by its calm temperament.
appearance: Two large faceted gems growing out of the head
Open hands with an opposable digit
lore.origin: One of the crystal-bearing forms the Luminax Generator grew to survive the light of the twin suns while working the fields.
lore.habitat: The sunward face of Luminax.
lore.feeding: It feeds on the light of the twin suns through the gems on its head.
lore.behavior: It is calm and slow and holds still, and the gems on its head transmit powerful light energy when it is provoked.
lore.company: It lives alone.

signatureAbility.name: Coronet of the Twin Suns
signatureAbility.description: The Crystorn holds still until its crystal horns release the light they carry in one narrow line.

records.name: Drilltail
records.nameOrigin: A direct compound naming the drill at the end of its tail.

lore.description: Dog-sized, scorpion-like creatures, Drilltails were originally used by wildcatters who lacked the funding to employ larger drilling Xalians like the Frackworm. Drilltails use their small, stinger-like drills to quickly tunnel through the earth, darting in and out of the surface as they hunt for prey to ambush with their sharp, scissor-like claws.
appearance: Dog-sized scorpion-like body on many legs
Scissor-like pincer claws on the forelimbs
Segmented tail arched over the back, ending in a helical drill
lore.origin: Used by wildcatters who could not afford larger drilling Xalians like the Frackworm.
lore.habitat: The wells and cavern networks beneath Endessa's dunes.
lore.feeding: It hunts by darting in and out of the surface and ambushing prey with its scissor-like claws.
lore.behavior: It tunnels quickly with the small drill on its tail, and it feels what moves overhead through the ground.
lore.company: Wildcatters kept several at a time. Left to itself it hunts alone.

signatureAbility.name: Wildcatter Auger
signatureAbility.description: The Drilltail runs a shaft beneath its quarry and comes up under it drill first.

records.name: Dromeus
records.nameOrigin: From the Greek dromeus, runner, reflecting the creature's defining ground speed and running launch.

lore.description: Partially feathered ground birds with lizard features, these creatures are extremely quick with razor sharp teeth. When running at high speeds, they can spread their wings to temporarily take flight as they launch into the air and sink their teeth into their prey.
appearance: Ground bird with lizard features, on two legs
Partly feathered, with bare hide between
Narrow lizard-like head with jaws of sharp teeth
Clawed forelimbs held clear of the ground
lore.origin: Magmuth's mining corporations designed it to cross the transient mineral islands, where a cooling lava flow gives only a short window before the ground opens again.
lore.habitat: The hardened lava flats and ash fields of Magmuth.
lore.feeding: It hunts on the flats and eats whatever it can run down.
lore.behavior: It runs. When it reaches speed it spreads its wings, launches itself at its prey, and bites.
lore.company: It runs in packs.

signatureAbility.name: Ashfall Stoop
signatureAbility.description: The Dromeus runs its target down, spreads its wings for the few seconds it can stay aloft, and closes the last of the distance with its teeth.

records.name: Ectoghoul
records.nameOrigin: A compound of ecto, evoking ectoplasm, and ghoul, matching its spectral body and delight in terror.

lore.description: Appearing as a spectral green mist that forms the vague impression of a grinning skull with a ghost-like tail for a body, Ectoghouls zip across the Dreadscape, emitting a terrifying cackle wherever they go. They seem to amuse themselves by terrorizing other Xalians, disappearing and re-appearing at will, passing through surfaces, and zapping their opponents with blasts of gooey ectoplasm.
appearance: Vague impression of a grinning skull
Ghost-like tail for a body, trailing off into drifting particles
lore.origin: One of the non-corporeal Xalians the abandoned Phantiri Generator produced after it rewrote itself under Leviticus Overdrive.
lore.habitat: The Dreadscape of Phantiri.
lore.feeding: It takes nothing in and feeds on nothing.
lore.behavior: It zips across the Dreadscape cackling, disappears and reappears at will, passes through surfaces, and zaps its opponents with blasts of gooey ectoplasm. It seems to amuse itself by terrorizing other Xalians.
lore.company: It roams alone, and it seeks out other Xalians only to torment them.

signatureAbility.name: Rictus of the Dreadscape
signatureAbility.description: The mist tightens into a grinning skull and lets out a cackle that reaches its target wherever it goes.

records.name: Figzy
records.nameOrigin: A playful, whimsical coinage chosen to fit the creature's mischievous spirit rather than describe a literal body part.

lore.description: What this creature lacks in stature it makes up for with its incredible magical abilities. It is deceptively smart, yet known to be docile when it trusts you.
lore.origin: Made by the Telypso Generator to help settle the unstable minds of the Vallerii marooned on the world, whom it treats as patients.
lore.habitat: The fungal forests and bioluminescent jungles of Telypso.
lore.feeding: It eats what the fungal forests offer.
lore.behavior: It is small, deceptively smart, and docile with those it trusts. It puts itself between a distressed mind and whatever is agitating it, holding one quiet and driving the other back with a burst from its open hands.
lore.company: It stays with those it trusts.

signatureAbility.name: Small Hands of the Psychosphere
signatureAbility.description: The Figzy raises both hands and the force it has been holding back leaves them all at once.

records.name: Foromeer
records.nameOrigin: A blend of Italian foro, hole, and meerkat, matching an upright creature whose drill hands bore through material for excavation.

lore.description: This creature has a metallic exoskeleton on its limbs, with long drill-like horns for arms. Thought to once be used for mineral excavation, its powerful horns can break through the strongest of material.
appearance: Tall biped on long jointed legs
Long drill-like horns for arms, longer than the body
A pair of long thin antennae swept back from the crown
lore.origin: Thought to have been used for mineral excavation on Veridium, its drill-like horns breaking through the strongest material.
lore.habitat: The ore-filled crust and heavy-metal veins of Veridium, among its factory trenches and forge districts.
lore.feeding: It eats what it finds in the trenches and forge districts.
lore.behavior: It opens the metal veins with its horns. It signals by drumming through the ground rather than by call, since the manufactory is too loud for anything else.
lore.company: It works the veins alone.

signatureAbility.name: Vein Breaker
signatureAbility.description: The Foromeer sets its drill hands against whatever stands in front of it and bores through.

records.name: Frackworm
records.nameOrigin: A compound of fracking, the pressure-fracturing process it performs, and worm, its body form.

lore.description: A colossal segmented worm with a ringed, drill-like head and a body that holds a slurry of sand under pressure, the Frackworm was generated on Endessa by the Syndicate's stolen prototype Generator to work the Nightcap wells. It bores down through the glass of the dead sea floor and forces its slurry into the seams at pressure until the rock fractures and the Nightcap pools drain toward the well. Wildcatters who could afford one opened a well in days that a crew of Drilltails took a season to reach, and the Nightcap Barons fielded them by the dozen. Today the Frackworms still work the cavern networks beneath the dunes, fracturing the substrate for the fortune-seekers who kept drilling after the Barons died.
appearance: Overlapping chitin plates ringed segment by segment
Ringed drill-like head with jaws at the working end
A single small eye on the collar behind the head
Vents along the body that spray its slurry
lore.origin: Generated by the Syndicate's stolen prototype Generator to open Nightcap wells for the wildcatters and the Nightcap Barons.
lore.habitat: The cavern networks beneath Endessa's dunes, down to the dead sea floor. It does not come to the surface.
lore.feeding: It takes its food from the sand and whatever is in it as it bores.
lore.behavior: It bores through sand and substrate, sets its head against a seam, and forces its pressurized slurry in until the rock fractures and the Nightcap drains toward the well.
lore.company: One worm opens a well by itself. The Barons fielded them by the dozen.

signatureAbility.name: Fracture the Seam
signatureAbility.description: The Frackworm sets its ringed head against a seam of the old ocean-floor substrate and drives its pressurized slurry in until the substrate fractures and the Nightcap runs.

records.name: Graviclaw
records.nameOrigin: A compression of gravity and claw, naming the force it controls and the massive pincer where that force terminates.

lore.description: With the black-shelled body of a crab and an upright torso, the centaur-like crustacean known as the Graviclaw lurks just beneath the foggy wetlands of Grimedes, using its bizarre control over the intensification of gravitational waves to generate miniature black holes in the water and draw its helpless prey right into its clutches. Graviclaws can strengthen the gravitational pull of their massive claws in order to snap them shut with a force many times heavier than their implied mass, severing through even the hardest of materials with crushing pressure. When facing larger foes, the Graviclaw can use its powers to root itself to the ground, becoming an immovable wall of chitin.
appearance: Centaur-like crustacean, crab body below and upright torso above
One massive pincer claw as long as the torso
lore.origin: Thought to come from the laboratory experiments on Grimedes, rumored to be ECHELON black sites, that produced the planet's gravity-bending Xalians.
lore.habitat: The foggy wetlands of Grimedes, just beneath the surface.
lore.feeding: It lurks under the water and draws prey to its claws with a miniature black hole rather than chasing it.
lore.behavior: It snaps its claws shut with a force many times its mass, cutting through the hardest materials. Against something too large to draw in, it roots itself to the ground and becomes an immovable wall of chitin.
lore.company: It lurks alone.

signatureAbility.name: Point of No Return
signatureAbility.description: It opens a claw beneath the water and collapses the gravitational waves inside it until nothing within reach can swim away from the closing grip.

records.name: Hippochamp
records.nameOrigin: A shortening of hippocamp, whose Greek roots evoke horse and sea monster, matching its horse body and seahorse head.

lore.description: Four-legged creatures resembling a seahorse that patrol the various hydro-processing fleets on Poseidas, Hippochamps were designed as emergency response crews for the various electrical and chemical fires that occur on rigs, as well as a means of defense against pirates seeking to steal valuable Algael. Their long, trunk-like snouts serve as high-pressure water cannons, and can maintain a steady stream that allows them to hose down fires and threats alike.
appearance: Long trunk-like snout, a water cannon
Sail-like crest from brow to neck
Fin-like spines continuing along the back
Thick tail coiled in a spiral
lore.origin: Designed as emergency response crews for the hydro-processing rigs of Poseidas, putting out electrical and chemical fires and holding off pirates after the Algael.
lore.habitat: The floating rig fleets on Poseidas's global ocean, above and below the surface.
lore.feeding: It eats what the ocean around the rigs gives.
lore.behavior: It patrols the rigs and hoses down fires and threats alike with the steady stream from its snout. When storms or the toxic algae blooms come over the rigs it drops below the surface.
lore.company: It works in crews.

signatureAbility.name: Hydrostatic Lance
signatureAbility.description: The long snout holds one unbroken high-pressure stream on a fire or a threat for as long as the pressure lasts.

records.name: Hypnopet
records.nameOrigin: A compound of hypnosis and pet, reflecting its trance-producing horn and origin as a therapeutic service animal.

lore.description: Hypnopets resemble glowing, golden-furred bunny rabbits with a single color-changing unicorn horn atop their heads. They were created by the Telypso Generator as service animals and therapists for the insane Vallerii imprisoned on the world, where their natural empathic healing abilities served to balance and treat patients. When their horn begins to pulse and swirl with psychedelic color, it hypnotizes others and locks them in a trance, which was useful for sedating patients when they entered into dangerous bouts of mania. With the Nemesis Plague reducing the patient population of Telypso, many Hypnopets have taken to the stars as healers, though some have been forced into service by King Kozrak, who uses their hypnotic abilities as crowd control on rebellious worlds.
appearance: Single color-changing unicorn horn atop the head
lore.origin: Created by the Telypso Generator as service animals and therapists for the insane Vallerii imprisoned there, using its empathic healing to balance and treat patients.
lore.habitat: The fungal forests and mists of Telypso, though many now travel the stars as healers.
lore.feeding: It grazes on what the overgrowth puts out.
lore.behavior: It reads the state of whoever is near it and steadies them. When its horn pulses and swirls with color it hypnotizes whoever is watching and locks them in a trance, which once sedated patients in dangerous manias and now serves King Kozrak as crowd control on rebellious worlds.
lore.company: It keeps close to its patients.

signatureAbility.name: Psychedelic Reverie
signatureAbility.description: Its horn pulses and swirls through shifting color until whatever watches it stops moving and stands quiet in the trance.

records.name: Imprit
records.nameOrigin: A compression of imp and sprite, matching its small demonic appearance and supernatural, erratic fire behavior.

lore.description: Imprits are demonic looking creatures, resembling flaming, horned monkeys backed by long tails with scythe-like tips. Imprits possess fire-retardant fur that protects their bodies from the flammable oils they secrete, allowing them to survive despite being in a state of constant immolation.  They are remarkably intelligent among other Xalians, having been designed in ancient times as natural tinkerers and let loose into the various lightless mining shafts of Magmuth, where they were left to their own devices to fix and maintain the often makeshift mining equipment sent deep into the earth by the Vallerii. Today, they are known for being entirely erratic, likely driven mad by the isolation of the deep tunnels in which they tinkered and toiled. When released from their claustrophobic confines and set loose on the surface, Imprits take ecstatic pleasure from using their tails to swing through the air from place to place and setting fires where they least belong.
appearance: Small horned monkey on all fours
Long whip tail with a scythe-like tip
lore.origin: Designed by Magmuth's corporations as a tinkerer and let loose in the lightless mining shafts to fix and maintain the makeshift equipment the Vallerii sent down.
lore.habitat: The old mining shafts of Magmuth and the crag networks above them.
lore.feeding: It eats what it finds in the shafts and on the surface, whatever it is.
lore.behavior: It climbs and leaps rather than crossing open ground, swinging from its tail as readily as from a hand. Underground it takes machinery apart and puts it back together. On the surface it is erratic, and it sets fires where they least belong.
lore.company: It keeps to itself, shaped by the isolation of the deep tunnels.

signatureAbility.name: Ecstasy of the Deep Shafts
signatureAbility.description: The Imprit wrings its flammable oils out across everything within reach and lets its own burning body set them alight.

records.name: Kosanos
records.nameOrigin: A joining of Polish kosa, scythe, and nos, nose, naming the broad cutting blade at the end of its long trunk.

lore.description: With a large blade at the end of its trunk, this simple yet powerful creature is thought to have been designed to clear the thick brush of Floria.
appearance: Large, heavy quadruped on thick columnar legs
Single long trunk arching over the back, ending in a blade as long as the body
lore.origin: Thought to have been designed to clear the thick brush of Floria.
lore.habitat: The underforests beneath the World Tree canopies.
lore.feeding: It feeds as it works, on the growth it opens up and whatever the opening turns up.
lore.behavior: It sets its feet, reads the ground, and fells standing growth in long low arcs of the blade on its trunk, then holds the lane it has cut.
lore.company: It moves in herds through the underforest.

signatureAbility.name: Understory Reaping
signatureAbility.description: The Kosanos swings its trunk in a long low arc and opens a lane through everything standing in it.

records.name: Luceras
records.nameOrigin: A stylized blend of Latin lepus, hare, and Greek keras, horn, matching its long-eared bounding frame and paired ram-like horns.

lore.description: This creature can jump so high that at times it seems as if it is flying. Once up in the air, it comes missiling down on its enemy like a battering ram.
appearance: Small bounding quadruped, built around its hind legs
A pair of curved ram-like horns
Whip tail longer than the body, ending in a spiked plume
lore.origin: One of the leaping animals the Saiphus Generator raised to bound between the floating islands as if gravity held no sway over them.
lore.habitat: The floating islands of Saiphus and the gaps between them.
lore.feeding: It grazes the rolling plains of the islands and drinks where vapor condenses in the canyons.
lore.behavior: It jumps so high it seems to fly, then comes missiling down on its enemy like a battering ram.
lore.company: It grazes in groups.

signatureAbility.name: The Long Fall of Saiphus
signatureAbility.description: The Luceras leaps until it seems to fly, then comes missiling down horns first on its enemy like a battering ram.

records.name: Neph
records.nameOrigin: A clipping of the Greek nephos, cloud, for the colossal creature that lives and feeds in Saiphus's atmosphere.

lore.description: Colossal hydrogen jellyfish that travel in free-floating herds across Saiphus's lower atmosphere, the Neph are instrumental to the Benthane industry. These domesticated creatures roam the clouds in flocks, grazing off of the biochemicals and atmospheric plankton contained in the gas-liquid slush of Saiphus's deeper atmosphere using long, trailing tentacles that vacuum up valuable Benthane along with their food. When threatened, these same tentacles can be used to pull in opponents with considerable suction or to jettison air at high pressure. Neph can also forcibly expel jets of Benthane gas, which is typically used a coolant for starship engines, from their tentacles in order to blast their enemies with freezing air. Finally, being composed almost entirely hydrogen means that the Neph can also spray their enemies with bouts of flammable gas.
appearance: Small central body beneath the bell
Long trailing hollow tentacles, open at the ends
lore.origin: Domesticated for the Benthane industry, which milks the Benthane its tentacles vacuum up along with its food.
lore.habitat: The cloud layers of Saiphus's lower atmosphere.
lore.feeding: It grazes on the biochemicals and atmospheric plankton in the gas-liquid slush of the deeper atmosphere, drawing them up through its long trailing tentacles.
lore.behavior: When threatened it pulls opponents in with suction, jets air at high pressure, blasts freezing Benthane from its tentacles, or sprays flammable hydrogen.
lore.company: It travels in free-floating herds.

signatureAbility.name: Benthane Coldwind
signatureAbility.description: The Neph forces the coolant gas banked in its tentacles out through their open ends, washing everything before it in a freezing white plume.

records.name: Newtapede
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of newt and centipede, matching its amphibious body and sixteen-legged segmented form.

lore.description: A 16 legged amphibious creature with a long, segmented body. While adapted to land, its slender frame and webbed feet make it a formidable opponent in water.
appearance: Long, arched, segmented body on sixteen legs
lore.origin: One of the water-breathing Xalians the Poseidas Generator produced once the seas rose and turned acidic.
lore.habitat: The water around and beneath Poseidas's rigs and underwater cities.
lore.feeding: It eats what it catches in the water and what it finds on land.
lore.behavior: It is at home on land but far more dangerous in water, where its slender frame and webbed feet carry it. What it catches it wraps its whole length around and holds under.
lore.company: It works among the other water-breathing Xalians of the rigs.

signatureAbility.name: Sixteenfold Undertow
signatureAbility.description: The Newtapede wraps its whole segmented length around a swimmer and holds it under.

records.name: Scalatto
records.nameOrigin: A blend of scale and the French tatou, armadillo, matching its scaly armor and ability to roll into a protective ball.

lore.description: Shielded by a scaly exoskeleton, this creature can roll into a ball to protect itself.
appearance: Scaly chitin exoskeleton in overlapping bands
Long low head with a blunt snout
Backswept spines running from the head down the neck
Long curved claws on the forelimbs
Very long banded tail with a hooked tip
lore.origin: One of the Xalians the Syndicate's stolen prototype Generator produced to work the drilling on Endessa.
lore.habitat: The dunes and cavern networks of Endessa, crossing the surface only in the low hours.
lore.feeding: It eats what it finds in the caverns and on the dunes in the low hours.
lore.behavior: It rolls into a ball inside its scaly exoskeleton to protect itself, and it feels the ground through its plating.
lore.company: It crosses the dunes alone.

signatureAbility.name: Duricrust Rolling Guard
signatureAbility.description: It draws its limbs beneath the banded plates and closes into a ball, and what strikes the shell is turned aside.

records.name: Smokat
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of smoke and cat, naming its feline silhouette and ability to atomize into smoke.

lore.description: Feline shaped in normal form, this clever creature can instantly atomize into a cloud of smoke for a sneak attack or quick evasion.
appearance: Lean feline shape held in a body of smoke, standing on two legs
Surface of smoke with no firm edge
Long tail whose tip trails off into loose smoke
lore.origin: One of the non-corporeal Xalians the abandoned Phantiri Generator produced after it rewrote itself under Leviticus Overdrive.
lore.habitat: The Dreadscape of Phantiri, inside its windless fog.
lore.feeding: It takes nothing in and feeds on nothing.
lore.behavior: It holds a feline shape, climbs and springs where the footing is bad, and instantly atomizes into a cloud of smoke for a sneak attack or a quick escape.
lore.company: It hunts alone.

signatureAbility.name: The Scattering Pounce
signatureAbility.description: It comes apart into smoke mid-stride, crosses the ground as haze, and is whole again with its claws already closing.

records.name: Sonalloy
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of sonic and alloy, naming the vibrations it uses to locate damage and the living metal it works into the repair.

lore.description: A low six-legged creature of living metal, the Sonalloy climbs Veridium's gantries and draws warm alloy from a broad extrusion vent beneath its front body, working it into damaged creatures and structures with a pair of fine tendrils and broad pincers.
appearance: A low broad body made entirely of satin-finished metal
Two small recessed eyes grouped on the lower forward slope directly above the extrusion vent
Six jointed load-bearing legs tipped with split gripping pads
A pair of broad facing pincers beneath the front of the body
Two fine tendrils that unfurl from recesses beside the pincers
A single broad downward-facing extrusion vent centered beneath the front body between the two tendril bases
A bare unplated surface crossed by slow-moving lines of forge glow
lore.origin: The Veridium Generator produced Sonalloys to maintain metal-shaping fauna and factory systems in forge districts where fractures accumulate faster than ordinary crews can answer them.
lore.habitat: They move along factory trenches, gantries, salvage fields, and the cooler banks of Veridium's liquid metal channels.
lore.feeding: They draw heat from forge districts and passing metal channels, retaining enough of it to keep a reserve of seam alloy mobile inside the body, and fold small pieces of scrap into that reserve to replace material spent on repairs.
lore.behavior: A Sonalloy drums across a damaged surface to map the break, braces it with its pincers, extrudes warm alloy between its tendrils, and uses them to draw the material directly into the fracture and work it until the join bears weight again.
lore.company: Several may converge on widespread breakage and coordinate through alternating patterns of seam glow, but they separate once the repair is stable.

signatureAbility.name: Ruin Made Whole
signatureAbility.description: The Sonalloy floods a wound or fracture with living alloy, then draws the support lattice tight with its tendrils while its pincers hold the damaged body still.

records.name: Terragoyle
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of terra and gargoyle, matching a stone-moving, horned bat-like guardian that waits in a statue-like state.

lore.description: Resembling horned and vaguely humanoid bats with elongated tails tipped with a levitating ball of stone, Terragoyles can be found lining the edges of the Chasm. They were originally used to airlift debris out of Stonera's strip mines with their levitational tails, but now stand guard over the perimeter in a statue-like state, hibernating to conserve their energy until a threat is detected. When awoken, Terragoyles rise high into the sky, using their tails to levitate boulders and fling them like great flying catapults across the Chasm beneath them or to carpet bomb intruders with strafing runs of gravel and rock as they soar overhead.
appearance: Horned, vaguely humanoid bat, hunched on all fours
Ribbed ram-like horns curling back from the skull
Long tail ending in a cradle, with a ball of stone levitating above it
lore.origin: Used to airlift debris out of Stonera's strip mines with its levitating tail.
lore.habitat: The edges of the Chasm on Stonera.
lore.feeding: It eats when it wakes, whatever the rim offers, and goes long stretches without.
lore.behavior: It stands guard over the perimeter in a statue-like state, hibernating to conserve energy until it senses a threat. Then it rises into the sky and uses its tail to levitate boulders and fling them across the Chasm, or carpet-bombs intruders with strafing runs of gravel and rock.
lore.company: It stands in a line with others along the rim.

signatureAbility.name: Perimeter of Standing Stones
signatureAbility.description: It wakes from its statue-like state, rises above the Chasm, and drops the boulders its tail holds aloft onto what crossed the rim.

records.name: Vespersyn
records.nameOrigin: A blend of the Latin vesper, evening, and Greek syn, together, reflecting a creature of perpetual night that moves its familiars as one unit.

lore.description: When in battle, this creature summons a swarm of small flying familiars with teeth like piranhas. It controls the swarm with its mind, attacking or defending as one unit.
appearance: Hooked claws on the forelimbs and feet
Surrounded by a swarm of summoned flying familiars, toothed like piranhas
lore.origin: One of the Xalians experimented on in the laboratories of Grimedes, rumored to be ECHELON black sites, rather than a labor form.
lore.habitat: The thick, stalky undergrowth of Grimedes, in permanent night.
lore.feeding: It eats what its swarm brings down.
lore.behavior: In battle it summons a swarm of small flying familiars with teeth like piranhas and controls them with its mind, attacking or defending as one unit. It keeps its own body inside the swarm so nothing can tell which shape matters.
lore.company: It goes with its swarm and nothing else.

signatureAbility.name: Unbidden Legion
signatureAbility.description: It calls up a wheeling cloud of small toothed familiars and sets them on a single target as one mind, and a familiar that is broken thins away.

records.name: Thirstaserp
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of thirst and serpent, naming its snake-like body and the venom that drains a victim's water.

lore.description: A large, cobra-like creature that hides beneath the sand, Thirstaserps emit a subsonic vibration from the rattles on their tails that can lure and mesmerize opponents long enough for them to draw near and attack with a unique venom that drains the victim’s water when bitten, causing them to suffer and die from extreme dehydration.
appearance: Viper's wedge head with long curved fangs
Tail ending in a rattle shaped like a lotus flower
lore.origin: One of the desert forms the Syndicate's stolen prototype Generator produced on Endessa. No record says what it was made for.
lore.habitat: Buried beneath the rolling dunes of Endessa.
lore.feeding: It bites with a venom that drains the victim's water and leaves it to die of dehydration.
lore.behavior: It hides beneath the sand and emits a subsonic vibration from the rattle on its tail that lures and mesmerizes opponents long enough for it to draw near and strike. It spreads its hood and shows its fangs before it does.
lore.company: It hunts alone.

signatureAbility.name: Thirst of the Endless Sea
signatureAbility.description: It buries its fangs and drains the water out of what it has bitten.

records.name: Tizzie
records.nameOrigin: A playful respelling of tizzy, a state of agitation or confusion, matching its spiral display and psychic disorientation.

lore.description: It uses its tail to draw attention to its big, hypnotic eyes. Once eye contact is made, this creature can attack from within your mind.
appearance: Big hypnotic eyes filling half the face
Long thin tail ending in a flat spiral disc, the lure
lore.origin: Raised by the Telypso Generator to counterbalance the psychic energies of the deranged Vallerii marooned on the world, as treatment rather than injury.
lore.habitat: The branches of Telypso's bioluminescent fungal forests.
lore.feeding: It takes its food from what the forests give.
lore.behavior: It uses its tail to draw attention to its big hypnotic eyes, and once eye contact is made it attacks from inside your mind. Since the Nemesis Plague turned Telypso's creatures against one another, Tizzies turn on each other the same way.
lore.company: It lives among others of its kind in the branches.

signatureAbility.name: Spiral of Perfect Attention
signatureAbility.description: It turns the disc of its tail until the eyes are the only thing worth looking at, and whatever meets them stops where it stands.

records.name: Venemist
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of venom and mist, naming the toxic cloud it sprays to dissolve prey.

lore.description: The toxic mist expelled from a tube in its mouth helps to dissolve its prey. With only 2 teeth, this tactic is necessary for the creature to survive.
appearance: Mid-sized four-legged hunter, heavier in front
Shaggy along the neck and back, smooth on the flanks
Wide gaping jaws holding two teeth, both long curved fangs
A tube in the mouth that sprays toxic mist
lore.origin: Made by the Drainov Generator to survive a world of acid swamps and industrial waste.
lore.habitat: The acid swamps and derelict chemical plants of Drainov.
lore.feeding: With only two teeth, it dissolves its prey with the toxic mist it expels from the tube in its mouth.
lore.behavior: It hunts by scent through smog too thick to see in.
lore.company: It hunts alone in the smog.

signatureAbility.name: Dissolution Veil
signatureAbility.description: The Venemist opens its jaws and drives a fanning mist through the tube seated in them, and what the mist settles on begins to come apart.

records.name: Voltish
records.nameOrigin: Built from volt, the measure associated with electricity, with a softened ending that turns it into a creature name.

lore.description: With bones and claws made from a tough, conductive metal alloy, this daunting creature can store electrical energy from its surroundings and release the shock into enemies.
appearance: Bones and claws of conductive metal alloy
Narrow head with a long muzzle
lore.origin: One of the expendable workforce the Zolton Generator sent onto the lightning fields. No record says what work it was made for.
lore.habitat: The deep canyons and metallic peaks of Zolton, where ground-borne lightning surges over the crust. It keeps clear of the black lightning dead zones.
lore.feeding: It feeds on electrical charge from its surroundings and on nothing else.
lore.behavior: It stores the charge it gathers in its alloy bones and releases the shock into enemies through its claws.
lore.company: It keeps to itself.

signatureAbility.name: Stormbank Discharge
signatureAbility.description: The Voltish drives the charge it has stored from its surroundings through its alloy claws into whatever they touch.

records.name: Xylum
records.nameOrigin: A stylization of xylem, the plant tissue that transports water and minerals, matching its rooted body and underground feeding.

lore.description: A giant organism of thick, intertwined roots that act as tentacles. It lives mostly underground as this is where it absorbs its power.
appearance: Giant squid-like organism, inverted, its mantle buried below the soil
Six thick root-like tentacles rising from the body, serrated along the edges
A mouth at the base where the tentacles meet
An eye on either side of the body at the soil line
lore.origin: Grown by the Genesis Prototype on Floria, the first Generator, which ran wild and filled the world with forms like it. No record says what it was made for.
lore.habitat: Underground in Floria's understory, beneath the World Trees, where it absorbs its power.
lore.feeding: It draws its power from the ground beneath the World Trees and eats nothing.
lore.behavior: It stays buried. When the ground above it is disturbed its tentacles come up out of the soil and wrap whatever is there, and a tentacle torn off grows back.
lore.company: It lies alone under the soil.

signatureAbility.name: Deeproot Reclamation
signatureAbility.description: Xylum sinks its buried limbs deeper and draws the ground's stored power up through them, taking with it whatever stands rooted or pinned in the soil above.

records.name: Yetimoth
records.nameOrigin: A fusion of yeti and mammoth, matching its hulking white-furred ape body and mammoth head.

lore.description: Hulking, white-furred apes with the heads of mammoths and tusks made of pure ice, the Yetimoths formed the rank and file of Krystos' prisonguards in ancient times.  If their enormous size and strength was not enough to keep prisoners in line, they could also form thick sheets of ice from thin air, covering themselves in a near-impenetrable armor, blocking off escape routes in walls of frost, or encapsulating their opponents until they could lumber over close enough to pummel them into submission with their meaty, ice-gauntleted fists.
appearance: Head of a mammoth, with a domed skull, fanned ears and a long trunk
Enormous tusks of pure ice, sweeping wider than the shoulders
lore.origin: Formed the rank and file of Krystos's prison guards in ancient times.
lore.habitat: The high-security prison complexes of Krystos's frozen tundra and the waste outside them.
lore.feeding: It eats what the frozen tundra gives, meat or otherwise.
lore.behavior: It forms thick sheets of ice from thin air, armoring itself, walling off escape routes in frost, or encasing an opponent until it can lumber close enough to pummel it with its ice-gauntleted fists.
lore.company: It holds a line with others beside it.

signatureAbility.name: Mantle of Unyielding Winter
signatureAbility.description: The Yetimoth draws thick sheets of frost out of nothing and layers them over its own pelt until the blows of its opponents stop reaching it.
